title: camissonia cheiranthifolia subsp. suffruticosa
intro: Camissonia cheiranthifolia subsp. suffruticosa, commonly known as Rock Primrose, is a plant species native to North America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Rock Primrose include its ability to act as an antimicrobial agent, inhibiting the growth of microorganisms, as well as its potential to exhibit vasodilatory effects, improving blood flow and lowering blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of Rock Primrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
